articles.title: India protest movement holds capital sit-in as police crack down on demonstrators - AP News
articles.description: Young protesters in India are camping on the streets of New Delhi. Protesters defied heavy security measures Thursday in the latest show of strength by a movement posing a major challenge to Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s government. Thursday’s demonstrations…
